test_title: PYST 6: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 24 March 2021 (Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A @ B means ‘A is daughter of B’

A × B means ‘A is mother of B’

A ÷ B means ‘A is husband of B’

If P ÷ T × U ÷ Q × C, then which of the following is NOT correct?
solution:
By decoding given data:

P ÷ T × U ÷ Q × C → P is Husband of T, T is Mother of U, U is Husband of Q, Q is Mother of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aff34082bcbedc24b2c0876fbfa8ed17956d1029eb797dfa131ff673eeae15d9.png] 

Family tree diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed8696671f6ae560fe630e367d967534271d250770d2772bdebf9a74da2099f4.png] 

1) U is the father of C → True

2) T is the grandmother of C→ True

3) P is the father-in-law of Q → True

4) Q is the daughter of T → False

Hence, Q is the daughter of T is not correct.
